description: A free, coach-focused video analysis tool for flag football teams. All processing happens in your browser — no account, no cloud, no subscription.

upload.title: Upload & Watch
upload.description: Load a local MP4 or paste a YouTube URL and start reviewing your footage immediately.

classify.title: Segment & Classify
classify.description: Mark timestamps, assign play types, and tag every segment with one click.

export.title: Export & Share
export.description: Download your analysis as CSV, JSON, or a ZIP with clipped video segments.

gameFootage.title: Game Footage
gameFootage.description: Upload a game video, mark segments, classify plays, and export your analysis.
